challenger.notes: Correctly identifies the poll-driven retry storm and preserves ownership safety, but the proposed cooldown-only regression misses the reviewed zero-progress close/verify cycle and does not require the bounded identical-failure cap across cleanup phases.

champion.notes: Correctly targets durable retry gating at the cleanup scheduling boundary with appropriate safety constraints, but its unavailable-endpoint regression would not expose the downstream-reviewed gate reset during zero-progress close/verify cycles or prove eventual suppression at the fixed cap.
